Study brief

Item Working scope
Dataset Thailand Road Accident [2019–2022], published by thaweewatboy on Kaggle
Required year 2022, using the incident date; timestamp interpretation needs checking
Proposed extent Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani, Samut Prakan, Samut Sakhon, Nakhon Pathom
Boundary source geoBoundaries Thailand ADM1; downloaded source represents 2017
Submission Quarto HTML technical report and revealjs executive summary

The six-area extent follows Thailand’s National Statistical Office grouping of Bangkok and Vicinities. The student still needs to document the actual boundary selection and assess the suitability of the boundary vintage for the 2022 study.

How to work

Open ISSS626-GAA.Rproj in RStudio, then follow the learning guide. Begin with its short study-design worksheet. Keep original data unchanged and store your scripts and figures in this exercise folder. The data notes explain where the downloads came from.

For each major visual, write an interpretation of at most 150 words. Keep the public-safety discussion within 500 words. The presentation has ten content slide slots plus a cover and contents slide.
